Tag 2 Soccer REAL Sushi Party Temple Run Super Star Car GoalHeads.io Rail in the Air Stickman Maze Run Fashion Legends Longcat We Become What We Behold Dreadhead Parkour Rodeo Stampede Decor Life Murder Mobile Games Obby Games Games for Girls 2 Player Games Tycoon Games Skill Games Mouse Games Popular Games .io Games Games for Boys Action Games Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Subway Surfers by SYBO Subway Surfers is an endless runner where you run on train tracks dodging oncoming trains and barriers. Collect coins to unlock new characters and hoverboards, and grab power ups to keep your run going as long as possible. Show more About Subway Surfers Runs start slow, then fill the screen with obstacles in seconds. One clean dodge becomes two, then three in a row as the game speeds up . You're reacting before you can see what's coming next. One late move ends the run, and you're straight back in trying to beat your last score. With over 17 million player upvotes , Subway Surfers is one of the most played games at Poki. Latest Subway Surfers World The latest Subway Surfers world takes you to the tropical Bali . Dash through lush jungle paths, race past vibrant temples, and soak in the colorful island vibes. Ready to explore paradise? Subway Surfer characters There are 9 main characters to play as in Subway Surfers. You start the game as Jake , the original Subway Surfer, and soon unlock Tricky . As you keep playing, more characters become available by spending coins. While these characters don't have any special abilities, they Here's how much you will need to get each character. Character Price Tricky 3 🪙 Yutani 500 🪙 Lucy 7,000 🪙 Tagbot 12,000 🪙 Ninja 20,000 🪙 Tasha 30,000 🪙 King 80,000 🪙 Brody 350,000 🪙 Subway Surfers gameplay Subway Surfers never stops moving forward. Around half a minute in, the speed jumps and obstacles start coming at you faster. One slow swipe and you slam into a train. It feels like you missed surviving by a split second , which is what makes you hit restart before you even think about giving up. Controls Subway Surfers uses simple controls that let you react quickly on both desktop and mobile. Knowing the controls is the difference between a high score and an instant crash. Here are the controls for both: Desktop: Left/right arrow: Move left/right Up arrow: Jump Down arrow: Roll Space: Activate hoverboard Mobile: Swipe left/right: Move left/right Swipe up: Jump Swipe down: Roll Double tap: Activate hoverboard Subway Surfers items There are 5 main types of items in Subway Surfers. Coins and keys unlock upgrades, while power ups, boosters and hoverboards help you survive longer. Coins and keys Coins and keys are the two in-game currencies that you collect as you play the game. Coins: This is the main currency that you can use to buy characters, hoverboards, power ups and boosters in the game. They line the tracks and pull you into tight lanes and late dodges. Going for more coins often means taking one extra dodge that ends the run. Keys: These are rarer than coins. Get them by unlocking awards or by opening Mystery Boxes. The blue keys are used to upgrade your hoverboards' special powers or to unlock new skins for your characters. Power ups There are 4 main power ups in Subway Surfers. Power ups give you short bursts of control when the run starts getting harder. These can be upgraded in the shop to help you survive longer runs . Spray Can Jetpack: Launches you above the chaos so you can ignore obstacles completely for a few seconds. Super Sneakers: Gain a temporary jump boost that lets you clear obstacles easier and reach hidden areas. Coin Magnet: Automatically collect all coins around you as you run through the level 2x Score Multiplier: Doubles your current score multiplier temporarily so you can get a higher score easier. Boosters There are 3 boosters that you can purchase or win from Mystery Boxes . These are single-use items that help you survive mistakes and beat your high score. Hoverboards: Hoverboards save you from one crash and keep the run alive. Score Booster: This blue star adds +5 to your current score multiplier. Headstart: Fly past the start of the level, allowing you to skip a portion of the run. Hoverboards Hoverboards give you one extra crash . When a bad landing would normally end the run, the hoverboard breaks instead and lets you keep going . Apart from the starting hoverboard, there are 15 hoverboards in Subway Surfers to unlock, each with its own special powers. Here is what hoverboard special powers do: Double Jump: Jump a second time when you're in the air. Stay Low: Roll under low obstacles automatically. Super Jump: Boosts your normal jump so you can jump higher. Smooth Drift: Fall slower after you jump. Speed Up: Increases your speed slightly by 12.5%. Zap Sideways: Change lanes instantly to avoid obstacles. Below you will see the hoverboards available, their powers and prices. Many of the hoverboards will have the special powers locked . To unlock them, you will need to buy them with keys. Hoverboard Special Powers Price Starboard Double Jump 0 🪙 Lumberjack Double Jump, Stay Low 1,500 🪙 Superhero Zap Sideways, Super Jump 1,500 🪙 Sunset Smooth Drift 4,800 🪙 Great White Speed Up, Smooth Drift 17,000 🪙 Monster Speed Up, Super Jump 25,000 🪙 Scoot Zap Sideways, Speed Up 30,000 🪙 Big Kahuna Stay Low, Smooth Drift 55,000 🪙 Skull Fire Double Jump, Speed Up 65,000 🪙 Daredevil Speed Up 75,000 🪙 Teleporter Zap Sideways 190,000 🪙 Bouncer Super Jump 240,000 🪙 Hot Rod Speed Up 240,000 🪙 Lowrider Stay Low 270,000🪙 Windglider Smooth Drift 300,000🪙 Mystery Boxes Collecting Mystery Boxes gives you one of 8 possible prizes . With useful boosts and rare jackpots, one good Mystery Box pull can turn a bad run into your best one . These can be found during runs , can be bought from the shop or are given as rewards for completing the Word Hunt missions. The prizes are: Special: Headstarts, up to 10 Hoverboards or up to 2500 coins Rare: Keys, Score Boosters, Trophies or 5000 coins Jackpot: 100,000 coins! Subway Surfers missions and awards Every mission and award pushes you to make risky moves and survive a little longer so you can unlock better upgrades and items . Word Hunt: Here you can see how far along the daily Word Hunt challenge you are. Every day, you must collect the letters S U R F E R while playing the game to unlock daily prizes. By completing this 5 days in a row you will get a Super Mystery Box . Missions: Missions push you into risky moves, rewarding you with permanent score multipliers . Chasing missions like rolling 30 times or getting 2000 coins from Mystery Boxes push you to keep playing and going further. Spraycan Awards: There are 12 awards, each with four tiers that reward you with keys. Bronze gives 3 keys, silver gives 5 keys, gold gives 8 keys and diamond gives 10 keys. Who created Subway Surfers? Subway Surfers was created by SYBO Games , a studio based in Denmark. First released in 2012, it quickly became one of the most played endless runners online, reaching over 1.8 billion downloads by 2021 . The game has been playable on Poki since 2019, bringing the same fast-paced experience straight to the browser. App The Subway Surfers app is available to download on mobile for both Android and iOS. Games like Subway Surfers at Poki If you enjoy the fast restarts and reaction-based pressure of Subway Surfers, running games like the Dino Game and Temple Run 2 offer the same "just one more run" feeling, where a bad crash sends you straight back in.
